```{r}
# Loop through output files generated by conStruct 
#   runs with K=1 through 5 and calculate the 
#   layer contributions for each layer in each run  

layer.contributions <- matrix(NA,nrow=6,ncol=6)

# load the conStruct.results.Robj and data.block.Robj
#   files saved at the end of a conStruct run
load("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/03_conStruct/cStrK1-10000-5/MacK01_conStruct.results.Robj")
load("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/03_conStruct/cStrK1-10000-5/MacK01_data.block.Robj")

# calculate layer contributions
layer.contributions[,1] <- c(calculate.layer.contribution(conStruct.results[[1]],data.block),rep(0,5))
tmp <- conStruct.results[[1]]$MAP$admix.proportions
Ks=c(1,2,5,6)

for(i in c(2,5,6)){
  j=i
    # load the conStruct.results.Robj and data.block.Robj
    #   files saved at the end of a conStruct run
    load(sprintf("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/03_conStruct/MacK0%s_conStruct.results.Robj",j))
    load(sprintf("C:/Users/rmohn/Desktop/10_Analysis/03_conStruct/MacK0%s_data.block.Robj",j))
    
    # match layers up across runs to keep plotting colors consistent
    #   for the same layers in different runs
    tmp.order <- match.layers.x.runs(tmp,conStruct.results[[1]]$MAP$admix.proportions)  

    # calculate layer contributions
    layer.contributions[,j] <- c(calculate.layer.contribution(conStruct.results=conStruct.results[[1]],
                                                             data.block=data.block,
                                                             layer.order=tmp.order),
                                    rep(0,6-j))
    tmp <- conStruct.results[[1]]$MAP$admix.proportions[,tmp.order]
}

ggplot(data=layer.contributions)+
  geom_boxplot(mapping=aes(x=))
```
